text:
marco_cs: Kestrel (customer) just filed a formal onboarding request — they want to run a 30B multilingual summarization model. Main asks: PHI-safe handling, on-prem/private deployment option, KMS/HSM integration, and latency target ~150ms p50. They attached a spec link: https://files.kestrel.example/summarizer-spec.pdf
amanda_cs: Thanks Marco — grabbing this. Adding to intake board and looping in eng + security. @eli_eng @rana_sec @onboarding-bot can you look? :eyes:
eli_eng: quick read — sounds feasible but we need more detail on sequence length and exemplar prompts. 30B typical mem/KV footprint is high; options: dedicated pool (8xA100) or heavy quantization (4-bit) for dedicated on-prem. Also: what qps and burst?
kestrel.customer: Hi all — thanks for the fast response. Expected baseline is 150 RPS (avg) with bursts up to ~400 for daily peak windows. Typical input length ~3-6 paragraphs (~600 tokens). Output ~100-300 tokens. Dataset contains clinical notes; PHI includes names, dates, identifiers. We can provide a redacted sample prompt set and eval labels.
rana_sec: PHI + KMS/HSM ok but need to scope key custody model. On-prem with customer-managed HSM is preferred for their compliance. We'll need: 1) PCI/PHI scoping matrix, 2) audit log requirements, 3) retention policy (they want 30-day ephemeral caching). Also flagging DFARS/ITAR? Kestrel is US healthcare, so SOC2 + HIPAA alignment only — no DFARS.
eli_eng: Got it. For performance we recommend: 1) quantized 4-bit variant for hosted fast path (cost-effective) + dedicated private nodes for the HSM/on-prem path, 2) enable prefix/KV caching but honor 30-day ephemeral retention, 3) a canary rollout with a small % of traffic to validate latency/quality.
onboarding-bot: [checklist created] Intake logged: #INTAKE-4829. Owner: amanda_cs. Tasks queued: security review, infra sizing, eval harness, customer enablement. ETA: initial scoping 3 business days.
amanda_cs: Scheduling an enablement + scoping call w/ Kestrel for Wednesday or Thursday this week. Proposed agenda: scoping, security requirements, sample prompts & eval plan, rollout timeline. Kestrel rep — which timezone are you in?
kestrel.customer: We're US Eastern. Wed 2pm ET works for our engineering/clinical lead. We'll share a redacted prompt set and a small labeled eval set by EOD Monday.
eli_eng: For the eval harness, here's a tiny snippet we can run locally to measure latency/quality across variants. Please drop the sample prompts into `samples.json` and run:```bash
python eval_runner.py --model candidate.pt --inputs samples.json --output results.json
```This will produce p50/p95 latency and rouge/bertscore outputs. I can push a template to the intake ticket.
rana_sec: Also capturing a non-negotiable: customer-managed KMS with HSM-backed keys for any secret material. If they can't provide HSM, we'll scope a dedicated Redwood HSM with restricted access and audit trail.
amanda_cs: Notes on renewal risk: low currently — Kestrel is actively expanding usage. But we should prioritize the dedicated/KMS ask; failure to meet compliance expectations could push renewal conversations. I'll make SLA and dedicated capacity options explicit in the scoping call.
marco_cs: Thanks everyone. Next steps recap for ticket #INTAKE-4829: amanda to run scoping call Wed 2pm ET, eli to prepare eval harness/template, rana to prepare compliance checklist + HSM options, onboarding-bot to track tasks. Kestrel to provide sample prompts + labeled eval by Mon EOD.
onboarding-bot: [update] Task assignment complete. Reminder set for Wed 14:00 ET.
